question: What is the number of players playing in a team in a hockey match?
solution:
Correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Each team consists of **11 players, one goalkeeper, and 10 outfield players**.
 
• The outfield positions include **defenders, midfielders, and attackmen.**
 
• The amount of which positions on the** field varies based on the style a team adopts** and who has the ball.
 
• **The 3-4-3 formation splits up the 10 field players **into **three defenders **(Centre Back, Right Back, and Left Back), **four midfielders** (Defensive Midfielders x 2 and Attacking Midfielders x 2), and **three strikers (Centre Forward, Right Wing, and Left Wing).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **A typical Cricket game has ******11 players****** in each team.** It is fundamentally very similar to baseball. It is played with a bat and a ball. The center of the field is a **rectangular area of 22 meters called a pitch.**
 
• I**n a football match, **each of the two competing teams can have **a maximum of 11 players** on the field at any time. **One of these has to be a goalkeeper while the other 10 are outfield players.**
 
• There are **seven players in the kabaddi team on each side** and the team that outs all the players on the opponent's side scores four extra points.
